summary: Reproduced both remaining PR 1070 counterexamples at PR 982 commit 956321de134fde54ee75b71aad60be1546163183. Replaced equal per-rank cached accounting at the six allocation guards with a host-local lock held across a live memory check and allocation, covering unequal in-job requests and cooperating separately launched jobs.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate rejected an aggregate-fitting 30 GiB rank at a 22.5 GiB equal share, and two isolated 60 GiB job contexts both accepted against 90 GiB usable.
Real spawned processes using the actual OS lock admitted all 30+20+20+20 GiB requests and admitted only one of two separate 60 GiB jobs against 90 GiB usable.
42 focused and adjacent host-pool tests passed, 1 skipped, with 15 subtests passed.
All configured formatting, lint, registry, and repository policy hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was visible, but the correction concerns CPU host-memory accounting and OS advisory locking; no GPU computation was used or claimed.

remaining_limitations: The exact 8xH200 GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 serving workload and model weights were unavailable.
No full-model, H200, multi-node, or real heterogeneous pipeline serving run was performed.
Cross-job coordination requires cooperating SGLang processes to share the host temporary directory; containers with isolated /tmp mounts and non-cooperating allocators remain outside the lock domain.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
